claim_boundary: Official Treasury material identifies daily constant-maturity par yields and their publication timing. Federal Reserve Bank of New York research supports the 10-year minus 3-month term spread as a real-time macroeconomic recession indicator, while Federal Reserve research notes 10-year minus 1-year or 2-year spreads as common but weaker alternatives. None of these sources validates Bitcoin timing. Exactly one preregistered matched-capital historical audit may test the frozen non-inversion policy; any failed primary or neighboring economic gate permanently closes this exact family without maturity, threshold, relation or timing search.

prior_matrix.identity: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Treasury Yield Curve Methodology
prior_matrix.finding: Treasury derives official constant-maturity par yields from indicative bid-side quotations near 3:30 PM Eastern and normally publishes the daily curve by 6:00 PM Eastern.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: An official yield curve and publication clock do not prove an investable Bitcoin return signal.

prior_matrix.identity: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Daily Treasury Rate Archives
prior_matrix.finding: Treasury publishes official CSV archives for daily par yield curve rates, preserves the December 2021 methodology series break and states that earlier rates remain official.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The sealed present-vintage bytes remain historical evidence and are not prospective OOS.

prior_matrix.identity: Estrella and Mishkin, The Yield Curve as a Predictor of U.S. Recessions, Federal Reserve Bank of New York, 1996
prior_matrix.finding: The paper identifies the 10-year Treasury minus 3-month Treasury spread as a simple predictor of U.S. recessions two to six quarters ahead.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Recession prediction is not next-day Bitcoin return prediction and does not establish that cashing out during inversion improves after-cost PnL or drawdown.

prior_matrix.identity: Engstrom and Sharpe, Don't Fear the Yield Curve, Federal Reserve, 2018
prior_matrix.finding: The note describes 10-year minus 1-year or 2-year yields as commonly cited long-term spreads but argues they can be statistically dominated by a near-term forward spread for recession prediction.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The two alternative short maturities are stability checks, not independently supported Bitcoin strategies or permission to choose the best result.

real_time_design_requirements: Use only the four named fields from the exact sealed Treasury source bundle; never fill, interpolate, revise or substitute a missing date or maturity.
Make each Treasury observation effective at 00:00 UTC on the following calendar day, after Treasury's normal 6:00 PM Eastern publication time, and persist the latest state until the next observation.
Freeze 10Y minus 3M as primary and 10Y minus 1Y and 10Y minus 2Y as the only neighboring definitions before BTC outcome access.
Use one zero-percent spread boundary for every variant, long-only 100-percent BTC or cash, next-H1-open fills, normal and doubled stress friction and zero cash yield.
Require matched-capital realized, unrealized and total PnL, drawdown, Calmar, upside capture, holding, terminal inventory, annual breadth, contribution concentration and both-neighbor stability.

Do not use the New York Fed fitted recession probability, monthly averaging, another maturity, threshold, smoothing, confirmation delay, BTC interaction, cash yield, fractional sizing, leverage or short leg after outcome access.
Do not open post-2024 data or create a Trading runtime rule from this audit.
uncertainty: The cited recession literature concerns U.S. macroeconomic activity, not Bitcoin returns.
Treasury rates are indicative par-curve estimates rather than executable transactions, and the methodology changed on 2021-12-06.
The source bundle is a sealed present-vintage historical download, not an original daily vintage archive or independent OOS.
A binary inversion state may remain unchanged for long periods and can sacrifice substantial BTC upside.
No BTC performance result, post-2024 observation, candidate, OOS or Trading path was accessed while freezing this prior.
